_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in your values. Do NOT commit config.json to version control.
_user_email_comment: The mailbox Rocky reads case folders from (James's mailbox with delegated access).
_rocky_email_comment: Rocky's own mailbox. Used as the sender for digest emails.
_cases_root_comment: Path to the Rocky Cases folder on OneDrive. Omit to use the default (James's dev laptop path).
_maple_comment: Maple daily activity digest (--maple-digest, 4:30 PM). Reads Maple's per-session JSONL logs and emails a per-user summary from rocky@. maple_logs_dir defaults IN CODE to the Rocky-laptop production path; override it here only on other machines (e.g. the dev laptop, where Maple mounts under the jbragdon profile). Set maple_digest_skip_if_empty:true to suppress the email on days with no Maple activity (e.g. weekends) — a missing logs folder still sends an alert regardless.
_remy_comment: Remy invocation paths. remy_cli_path is where remy_cli.py lives on disk. remy_outputs_path is where generated drafts get written.
_remy_delivery_comment: Email addresses that receive Remy draft delivery after generation.
_kill_switch_comment: Email addresses authorized to send ROCKY STOP / ROCKY START commands.
_pending_llt_comment: SharePoint config for the Pending LLT Matters pipeline. Templates path points to the Jinja2 email template folder.
_pma_comment: PMA NegotiationWatch. HubSpot writes are ASLEEP by default and require TWO affirmative switches: pma_hubspot_enabled:true here (master) AND running 'rocky.exe --pma-arm' (runtime arm flag). Either one absent = writes off. During the observe week leave both off: Rocky polls, classifies, and LOGS proposed updates only. '--pma-sleep' disarms.
_pma_mailbox_comment: pmateam@ is a Microsoft 365 Group (not a readable mailbox), so it forwards to rocky@. Rocky polls its OWN inbox and keeps only mail addressed (To/Cc) to pma_recipient_filter.
_pma_forwarder_comment: Senders whose mail is treated as PMA review material even when pma_recipient_filter is NOT in To/Cc — e.g. PMA negotiation emails forwarded in from the client. Matched on exact From address (case-insensitive).
_pma_corpus_comment: Knowledge corpus. Rocky saves every pmateam email + draft into per-deal folders under pma_team_root and synthesizes briefs daily via --pma-knowledge. Omit pma_team_root to default to a 'PMA Team' folder beside Rocky Cases on OneDrive.
_hubspot_property_comment: Confirm these internal property names via GET /crm/v3/properties/tickets before go-live. hubspot_summary_property is the custom 'Summary Status' field; the internal name may differ.
_pma_activity_comment: PMA Activity exporter (--pma-activity, once daily). Rocky pulls new emails from pma_activity_folder in pma_activity_mailbox and appends each (full body + extracted attachment text) as one JSONL line to pma_activity_feed.jsonl in maple_activity_dir, for the Maple Updater Agent to read. No classification/HubSpot/email. First run with no cursor backfills pma_activity_backfill_days. maple_activity_dir defaults IN CODE to the Rocky-laptop production path (under the rocky profile, same base as maple_logs_dir); override it here only on other machines (e.g. this dev-laptop value, under the jbragdon profile). rocky@ needs EDIT (not view-only) share access to the Maple updater agent folder to write the feed.
maple_activity_dir: C:\Users\jbragdon\OneDrive\OneDrive - gejlaw.com\Program Files\Maple\Maple updater agent\PMA Activity
_email_brain_comment: Email Brain (--email-brain). Pulls ALL of James's sent mail from sent_brain_folders into a local SQLite DB (brain.db, with FTS5) + a raw sent_emails.jsonl export, pairs each reply with the inbound message it answered (via conversationId), and embeds the retrieval-key text via Voyage AI for similarity search. DB/JSONL live in email_brain_dir (blank = C:\Rocky\email_brain — LOCAL and private, not OneDrive). Reads via the app-level token + Application Access Policy (covers jbragdon@ AND rocky@); no new Graph permission. voyage_api_key from voyageai.com; voyage_model defaults to voyage-3-large.
_sent_brain_folders_comment: Each entry is either a bare path string (read from sent_brain_mailbox) or {mailbox, path}. Current sent mail lives in jbragdon@'s Sent Items. The Online Archive ('__Older Sent Items') is a separate In-Place Archive mailbox Graph CANNOT read, so drag those archived sends into a DEDICATED folder in rocky@ (e.g. create 'Inbox\James Older Sent' first — do NOT use Rocky's bare Inbox or you'll ingest Rocky's operational mail) and point an entry at it. sent_brain_author is the single identity treated as 'James' for pairing, even when the host mailbox is rocky@.
